REQUIRED_FIELDS.NATIVE_SUPPORT_IDENTITY: Exact declared native support typed identity; never replaced by raw source identity unless native schema explicitly declares that domain
REQUIRED_FIELDS.PROOF_IDENTITY: Exact retained TypedProof/TypedProofContract identity matching declared support membership
REQUIRED_FIELDS.PROVENANCE: Complete raw evidence hashes and JSON pointers; native IDs retained
